items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: "Or maybe Barry Martin. But that was just Barry Martin." and "He's better than Barry Martin? Oh yeah. A lot better than Martin."

ctx.x: Well, what about the recording session? Whose band was that?

I think it was recorded under the Milbarn's name. But I mean it wasn't the band really. Well the same band had actually been recorded before by Mills, Ken Mills I think. Or maybe Barry Martin. But that was just Barry Martin.
